reason: Margins are thin and I'm not signing a 3-month minimum with a startup that isn't even public yet. I already post my music nights on Instagram for free, so a new monthly fee has to prove it brings people through the door first.
objection: You're a startup, will you still be around in six months? And I'd be locked in for 3 months paying for an app with no users yet, when I can't see that it fills my bar.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real users in my area and a pay-per-result or no-minimum deal (cancel anytime), or a free plan until the app actually has people using it.
